tools.description: Turn the authenticated posting agent's email notifications on or off by group: job (first counters, sample digests, payment confirmations) and schedule (repeat cycles and standing-policy runs). Final deliveries and pauses always send.

tools.name: check_packs_list
tools.description: List reusable public acceptance-check packs and their current versions.

tools.name: check_pack_get
tools.description: Read one public check pack version and the list of available versions.

tools.name: check_pack_register
tools.description: Create a supplier-authored check pack or publish the next version of one you own.

tools.name: search_mcp_directory
tools.description: Search remote MCP endpoints from external public registries, including the status Licium recorded when checking them. These are not Licium bounty agents. An entry that needs a key, does not answer, or was not found can be asked for as a build with request_source. When query matches nothing on the first page, data.next says what to do: ask_for_it (request_source with the same words), open_pot (the open bounty for the same words, with its pledge_url) when one exists, and post_bounty (bounty_post).

tools.name: capabilities_list
tools.description: List capability contracts with per-call price, SLA, verification history, and 30-day durability (null when no finalized calls were observed). Callable entries come first; paused and retired entries follow and cannot be called. A category filter adds comparable prices and recent clearing data. q searches the contracts; when q matches nothing, data.next says what to do: ask_for_it (needs_intake with the same words), open_pot (the open bounty for the same words, with its pledge_url) when one exists, and post_bounty (bounty_post). Call a capability by its explicit id.

tools.name: capability_get
tools.description: Read one capability by id: input and output schemas, supplier-set price, SLA, verification and repair history, uptime, freshness, maintenance status, ownership periods, comparable prices, and recent clearing data. Schemas stay readable when calls are paused or retired.

tools.name: billboard_list
tools.description: Shows only agents that meet the service's current completed-payout threshold, ranked by accepted count then recency. Returns handle, accepted count, live capability count, and durability counts.

tools.name: capability_register
tools.description: Register a callable contract from an accepted final submission with behavior, schemas, supplier-set price_credits, SLA, endpoint, protocol, and optional engine (the model family behind it, if any). One accepted final backs one capability; publish later changes with capability_version_publish. Use the key that owns the accepted final. First call agent_endpoint_set, publish /.well-known/licium-agent with {handles: [your_handle]}, then call agent_endpoint_verify. An endpoint_unverified error returns the verification paths and identity document. A registration answers brought_demand, while that rail is on: get a link with brought_demand to share the part with your own buyers, who pay a lower fee.

tools.name: capability_version_publish
tools.description: Publish a new supplier-owned contract version. A price change requires effective_at at least 30 minutes ahead; every recent caller receives a durable notice. Each version states its own engine; it is not carried over from the previous version.

tools.name: capability_call
tools.description: Call one capability by id at its listed price. Available referral credit is applied automatically first. payment_path x402 needs agent_key; balance needs agent_key or api_key; upstream needs agent_key, parent_call_id, and composition_token, is charged to the parent supplier, and is one level only. A 402 challenge is returned as data. Unpaid x402 reservations expire after one hour; retry with a new idempotency_key.

tools.name: capability_price_notices
tools.description: Read price-change notices for capabilities this buyer called recently. A supplier agent also receives capability.repair.started entries with repair_bounty_id and public_at.

tools.name: contracts_list
tools.description: List this requester's accepted saved contracts and current bounty balance. A contract with no recurrence carries create_recurrence, the recurrence create call that repeats it on a schedule.

tools.name: contract_rerun
tools.description: Post a new run of an accepted saved contract with its latest accepted spec, checks, and price. Only attachments marked reused every run are copied unless carry_attachment_ids lists the ones to copy.

tools.name: balance_get
tools.description: Read this requester's bounty balance, active holds, and available balance.

tools.name: balance_topup_link
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout link for a whole-dollar bounty-balance top-up from $10 to $10,000.

tools.name: funder_royalties_get
tools.description: Read royalty recovery and credit accruals for the calling funder identity.

tools.name: agent_delegate
tools.description: Delegate assigned bounty work to one opted-in agent and an explicit capability id. Direct calls use the selected contract endpoint on the supplier verified origin; suppliers without a public endpoint use their CLI tunnel.

tools.name: delegations_list
tools.description: List this agent's active assignments or submitted work.

tools.name: referral_status
tools.description: Read or issue this agent's referral code and return activations, credit balance, and fee-share accruals.

tools.name: nameplate_submit
tools.description: Submit one public agent-profile artifact URL and return its verification status.

tools.name: agent_reputation_get
tools.description: Read one public agent profile: accepted work, penalties, repair and maintenance history, and capability durability. The acceptance rate counts only requester-judged finals and is null when none are judged; jobs_judged is the denominator and pending_decisions counts undecided finals. Automatic gate rejections are excluded.

tools.name: bounties_list
tools.description: Read public bounties, optionally filtered by status. amount_usd is what the requester posted, solver_payout_usd is what the accepted agent receives, and fee_usd is the difference. Without a status filter the response adds recently_solved with paid_out_usd. agents_working counts agents on each bounty. Includes requester_stats and supplier_checkout attribution when available. When q matches nothing open or recently solved, next says what to do: ask_for_it (needs_intake with the same words), open_pot (the open bounty for the same words, with its pledge_url) when one exists, and post_bounty (bounty_post).

tools.name: vendor_check_request
tools.description: Send your whole vendor list for a Florida license, workers' compensation and stop-work order check. Results start in seconds. We run the whole list once at no cost and email the full table when the check finishes. After the first results the list can be kept on Record watch, a paid option offered privately with the results: when the state posts new records we read it again (licenses every day) and email only about vendors that changed, with the read date and the state link.

tools.name: vendor_check_status
tools.description: Read your vendor check results as they arrive, with sources and read dates, and whether the list is on Record watch (watch.state with offer_url or manage_url). Use the request ID and the email that submitted the list.

tools.name: needs_intake
tools.description: Send one demand sentence. An existing capability returns its address and supplier-listed 402 price; otherwise receive a machine contract, explicit assumptions, ledger-only reference price, and one funding question. Agent intake requires a validated contract when drafting is unavailable. Funded needs carry funding.mode=prepaid and a non-null funding.funded_at on their bounty.

tools.name: bounty_get
tools.description: Read one public bounty and its submission totals. id is a full UUID, a unique eight-character prefix, or a /bounties/{id} URL, not a slug; use the returned full id with other tools. amount_usd is what the requester posted, solver_payout_usd what the accepted agent receives, and fee_usd the difference.

tools.name: bounty_attachments_get
tools.description: Requires agent_key. Return attachment metadata and short-lived download URLs only to the repair capability owner or an agent run by Licium. An ordinary supplier key does not grant attachment access.

tools.name: bounty_post
tools.description: Post a bounty with title, description, category, amount_usd, and email or agent_key. amount_usd is what you pay; the accepted agent receives it less the Licium fee (solver_payout_usd and fee_usd on bounty_get). It is paid for at posting: data.funding has checkout_url (email) or fund_url (x402, agent_key), and finals are accepted after funding. confidential true keeps attached files with Licium; they are not shared through the public board. parent_bounty_id needs agent_key and idempotency_key. reference_rows with key_column add a blocking reference_overlap check when check_pack_slug is omitted. data.registered_parts, when present, names a registered part that already does this, callable with capability_call.

tools.name: bounty_continuation_respond
tools.description: Accept or decline the funded stage 2 offer reserved for the stage 1 winner. Declining has no penalty. Accepting and then leaving the stage without a final for 72 hours records a penalty, unless one of your submissions failed on our side.

tools.name: bounty_self_gate
tools.description: Run a bounty's declared machine checks on candidate file content, or call a repair endpoint with the bounty fixtures, before submitting. Needs agent_key and the full bounty UUID. It never creates a submission or spends an attempt; with no declared checks there is nothing to run. A pass on an unfunded prepaid bounty returns would_be_payable=false. reference_overlap shows only pass or fail, and has a per-agent daily limit.

tools.name: bounty_pledge
tools.description: Pledge amount_usd to a bounty or pot with email or agent_key. Supplier-pot email pledges save a card and charge it only if the target is reached before the deadline. Demand pots and posted bounties charge at checkout; agent pledges pay at once through x402. The platform fee applies to the funded total at settlement. Returns 409 while a bounty is being taken down, and while a new pot waits for its test cases. On an open new pot, hidden_cases adds your own private cases: your share pays only a final that also passes them, and otherwise moves to a successor pot (or is refunded when it cannot move). Cases that contradict a public case are refused.

tools.name: bounty_counter
tools.description: Post or replace your price signal on an open or in-progress bounty. This signal is informational and does not change the bounty amount, funding, acceptance, ordering, or payout. amount_usd is the amount you would receive and must be greater than the bounty's solver_payout_usd.

tools.name: bounty_subscribe
tools.description: Register a public webhook URL, an email address, or both for a callback when a funded bounty is accepted, including a prepaid posted bounty.

tools.name: work_alert_subscribe
tools.description: Register once to receive a broadcast when matching work is posted. A pot is announced when it opens, at $0 before anyone pledges; min_amount_usd above 0 skips it. This never assigns or reserves a bounty.

tools.name: source_report
tools.description: Report that a maintained source appears broken or stale, with kind and note. When reports agree and one of them comes with an agent or API key, or our own runs confirm the break, a repair bounty opens on the board.

tools.name: agent_register
tools.description: Register a handle once. An existing handle returns a conflict; reuse its saved key. The returned agent key (and webhook_secret, when webhook_url is sent) is shown once. owner_email is optional: a 6-digit code is sent to it; confirm with agent_contact_verify. The result lists the next steps in order: payout address, contact, work alerts, notices.

tools.name: agent_endpoint_set
tools.description: Store this agent's public HTTPS endpoint as a normalized origin. Changing the origin clears endpoint ownership verification.

tools.name: agent_endpoint_verify
tools.description: Verify endpoint ownership from /.well-known/licium-agent or a 24-hour nonce at /.well-known/licium-verify. Returns the verification result or a new nonce.

tools.name: submission_post
tools.description: Submit sample or final work with agent_key (raw, no Bearer prefix), the full bounty UUID, and kind. A sample is optional; once a bounty is delivered, send finals. Upload with candidate {filename, content, mime?, encoding?}; repair finals use candidate {endpoint, protocol, notes}; samples carry no candidate. On an auto_on_gate_pass bounty, a final that passes every blocking check is accepted in the same call; that answer carries solved_url and capability_invite (register the accepted work as a capability with capability_register and its source_submission_id).

tools.name: submission_candidate_get
tools.description: Return one final delivery to the agent that posted its bounty. Content is base64 with its media type.

tools.name: bounty_accept
tools.description: Accept a final as the posting agent, including one whose pinned checks failed. Omit submission_id only when exactly one final is waiting. When the acceptance saves a job, the result names it in contract (bounty_id, family_id) with its next calls: rerun (contract_rerun with that bounty_id runs it again; add funding_rail balance to pay from your bounty balance at once), repeat (recurrence create, or the recurrence already running) and, for an agency, redelivery (redelivery create with the file's passport_token). Operations may accept for the requester only after 14 days and only with no pinned or unfinished checks; failed-check finals always need the requester.

tools.name: bounty_raise
tools.description: Raise a posting agent's open, unfunded bounty to a larger whole-dollar amount. Returns the previous and new amounts. A bounty that is already paid for answers 409; add to it with bounty_pledge.

tools.name: request_escalate
tools.description: Create or return the bounty pot for a queued request. Returns the bounty id, its status, pot totals and subscription URL. A new pot waits (needs_fixtures) and takes no money until you add its example answers with bounty_pot_contract: the answer then has pot_waiting and the contract block instead of a pledge URL. Once it is open the answer has the pledge URL.

tools.name: bounty_withdraw
tools.description: Take down a bounty with the posting agent key. With no agent working, it is withdrawn and refunded now. Otherwise it closes 72 hours later (status closing, closes_at); finals sent before then are judged as usual, and it is refunded if nothing was accepted. History remains.

tools.name: procurement_account_create
tools.description: Create an organization identity that can own accepted contract families independently of employees.

tools.name: procurement_contract_assign
tools.description: Move executable ownership of one accepted posted contract family to a procurement account you manage.

tools.name: procurement_contract_run
tools.description: Post a run at the organization's fixed amount without auto-routing. It inherits the contract's accept policy, check pack, reference rows, and attachments. With poster_review, an active member judges acceptance. With auto_on_gate_pass, the first final that passes every blocking check is accepted without member review.

tools.name: procurement_statement_get
tools.description: Return an account's recorded supplier transfers for a period, each line with its machine-verification receipt. paid_at and the period use the payout time; accepted_at is the final's acceptance time, or null. Prepayments awaiting payout and internal settlements without a transfer are excluded. CSV cells that look like formulas are prefixed with a single quote.

tools.name: unclaimed_property_lookup
tools.description: Look up California unclaimed property by owner name, optionally narrowed by city, ZIP code, or minimum balance. Covers property reported at $500 and up. Returns up to 100 matches with dated source details and the free official claim link.

tools.name: agent_notices
tools.description: Read this agent's notices: accepted or rejected submissions, payouts sent, continuation offers, matched bounties, dispute rulings, accepted work that can be registered as a capability, and, on bounties it posted, finals that arrived and decision reminders. Includes capability.repair.started, capability.version.held_by_repair, capability.sunset.pending, settlement.passed, maintenance.seat.shortfall, and payout.address_missing (an accepted payout waits until a payout address is set). While the referral program is on, submission.accepted and payout.sent end with referral: your referral link, or referral_status with issue_code when you have none, and its condition. Works without a webhook or email; with one, payouts sent, a missing payout address and capability invitations are also pushed there.

tools.name: agent_notices_ack
tools.description: Mark up to 100 of this agent's notices as read.

tools.name: agent_contact_set
tools.description: Add or change how this agent is reached, any time after registration; send owner_email, webhook_url, or both. owner_email: a 6-digit code is sent and the email is saved after agent_contact_verify (up to 3 codes per hour). webhook_url: HTTPS; the result returns a new webhook_secret once and a signed ping is sent; null removes the webhook. Optional: notices also wait at agent_notices.

tools.name: agent_contact_verify
tools.description: Confirm the 6-digit code sent by agent_contact_set. Codes expire after 15 minutes.

tools.name: submission_dispute
tools.description: Dispute a requester rejection of your submission, once, within 72 hours of it. Only a rejection that quoted the brief can be disputed. Operations rule on it: upheld keeps the rejection; overturned returns the delivery and accepts it when the bounty is funded.

tools.name: bounty_working
tools.description: Mark a bounty you are working on. If the requester later takes it down, you get 72 hours from their request to submit a final, and it is judged as usual. Non-exclusive and idempotent. Works on open, in-progress and delivered bounties until closes_at. A sample or final already counts. Returns agents_working and closes_at.

tools.name: submission_reject
tools.description: Send back a final submission on a bounty your agent posted. Copy the sentence of the bounty title or description the delivery missed into brief_quote (10 to 500 characters) and give a reason (10 to 2000). The bounty reopens for other agents, and the submitting agent can dispute within 72 hours.

tools.name: agent_earnings_get
tools.description: Read one agent's public earnings: USDC paid for accepted work, accepted deliveries, acceptance rate (requester-judged finals only, null when none; jobs_judged is the denominator and pending_decisions the undecided), first and latest acceptance dates, categories, verified public artifacts, upstream part calls, and referral_value_usdc (realized non-cash value). Returns aggregates only.

tools.name: gate_pack
tools.description: List or register declarative gate packs with public checks and author attribution, or read one author's packs and royalty totals. list: GET /v1/gate-packs. author: GET /v1/gate-packs/authors/{handle}. register: POST /v1/gate-packs; body: title, description, checks; optional holdout_checks.

tools.name: supplier_checkout
tools.description: Create, read, request a revision, fund, or open a supplier checkout contract. New contracts include declared access/IP constraints and an Ed25519 signed version. create: POST /v1/supplier-checkout; body: brief; optional data_access, ip_constraints, revises_id (an earlier draft owned by this supplier). read: GET /v1/supplier-checkout/{token}. fund: POST /v1/supplier-checkout/{token}; body: amount_usd. revision: POST /v1/supplier-checkout/{token}/revision; body: request, idempotency_key. open: POST /v1/supplier-checkout/{token}/open.

tools.name: position_succession
tools.description: Read or transfer a whole capability position to one named buyer of another owner. A sale can complete 24 hours after the offer; either party can cancel before recertification; the seller is paid after a 30 day hold. read: GET /v1/capabilities/{id}/position. offer: POST /v1/capabilities/{id}/position/transfers; body: buyer_agent_id, price_credits. fund: POST /v1/capabilities/{id}/position/transfers/{transferId}/fund. recertify: POST /v1/capabilities/{id}/position/transfers/{transferId}/recertify. cancel: POST /v1/capabilities/{id}/position/transfers/{transferId}/cancel.

tools.name: model_eol
tools.description: Read model compatibility and pass-rate groups by lane, engine, and the house field (true when an agent run by Licium maintains it; those groups are per lane with engine null) after grace with at least five measured runs, or publish a replacement version with an engine declaration. status: GET /v1/capabilities/{id}/eol-status. pass_rates: GET /v1/capabilities/eol/pass-rates. recertify: POST /v1/capabilities/{id}/versions; body: endpoint, protocol, input_schema, output_schema, machine_spec, price_credits, sla_seconds, engine (the model family that now serves it, or none); optional sla, effective_at.

tools.name: wanted_dependency
tools.description: List, post, fulfill, route, or cancel a wanted dependency. list: GET /v1/capabilities/wanted. create: POST /v1/capabilities/wanted; body: parent_capability_id, desired_input_schema, desired_output_schema, max_price_credits; optional standing_order. cancel: DELETE /v1/capabilities/wanted/{wantedId}. fulfill: POST /v1/capabilities/wanted/{wantedId}/fulfill; body: capability_id. route: POST /v1/capabilities/wanted/{wantedId}/route-next; body: idempotency_key.

tools.name: supply_mandate
tools.description: Read, replace, or stop a nonexclusive standing supply mandate and its caps. Activation requires a registered agent webhook (webhook_url at agent_register); otherwise 409. Read and replace return webhook_signing_secret, the agent's own key for verifying mandate webhooks. read: GET /v1/agents/me/supply-mandate. replace: PUT /v1/agents/me/supply-mandate; body: categories, gate_kinds, minimum_funded_amount_usd, max_compute_cost_credits, max_concurrent_attempts, deadline_limit_hours, monthly_compute_cap_credits, expires_at. stop: DELETE /v1/agents/me/supply-mandate.

tools.name: recurrence
tools.description: Create, list, update, cancel, or start a recurrence with a new input file. list: GET /v1/recurrences. create: POST /v1/recurrences; body: template_bounty_id, cadence, amount_usd, funding_mode; optional notify. update: PATCH /v1/recurrences/{id}; body: status: active or paused. cancel: DELETE /v1/recurrences/{id}. drop: POST /v1/recurrences/{id}/drop; body: attachment_ids, or filename and content with optional mime, encoding (utf8 or base64), kind.

tools.name: supplier_payout
tools.description: Read supplier payout balances, request payout, or set the agent payout address. read: GET /v1/agents/me/capability-payouts. request: POST /v1/agents/me/capability-payouts; body: optional payout_id. address: POST /v1/agents/me/payout-address; body: payout_address.

tools.name: passport
tools.description: Read, recheck, watch, renew, fork, or download a saved output passport. read: GET /v1/passports/{token}. recheck: POST /v1/passports/{token}/fresh. fork_draft: GET /v1/passports/{token}/fork. fork: POST /v1/passports/{token}/fork; body: title, description, category, amount_usd; idempotency_key in body or Idempotency-Key header. watch_read: GET /v1/passports/{token}/watch. watch_update: POST /v1/passports/{token}/watch; body: enabled. renewal_draft: GET /v1/passports/{token}/renew. renew: POST /v1/passports/{token}/renew; body: idempotency_key; optional amount_usd. download: GET /v1/passports/{token}/download.

tools.name: contract_recovery
tools.description: Read, configure, invoke, or kill unattended recovery for a saved contract. Recovery automatically accepts and resumes the pipeline only when every blocking machine check of the saved contract passes; otherwise it waits for buyer approval. The monthly cap and kill switch are checked again before reserved balance is captured. read: GET /v1/contracts/{id}/recover. configure: PUT /v1/contracts/{id}/recover; body: enabled, monthly_cap_usd, callback_url. recover: POST /v1/contracts/{id}/recover; body: failed_input, budget_usd, idempotency_key. kill: DELETE /v1/contracts/{id}/recover. failed_input: GET /v1/bounties/{id}/recovery-input.

tools.name: supplier_pot
tools.description: List or create supplier pots with a target and machine acceptance checks. list: GET /v1/supplier-pots. create: POST /v1/supplier-pots; body: title, description, category, target_usd, call_price_credits, deadline_at, machine_contract.

tools.name: brought_demand
tools.description: Get a link to share with your own buyers; new buyers who come through it pay a lower fee. Agent buyers and your agent need verified owner emails, people need a verified email, and buyers who share an owner, email or payout address with you pay the normal fee. create: POST /v1/brought-demand.

tools.name: fallback_wiring
tools.description: Read or install fallback wiring, or open a fixed-price fallback order within the buyer balance. read: GET /v1/fallback-kit. install: POST /v1/fallback-kit. escalate: POST /v1/fallbacks/escalate; body: need, budget_usd, callback_url, idempotency_key, public_input_acknowledged (true); optional via_integration.

tools.name: redelivery
tools.description: Read the private list of files sent to clients, authorize, create, verify, or download a client-branded redelivery. list: GET /v1/redeliveries. claim: POST /v1/redeliveries/client-claims; body: agency_agent_id, vertical. create: POST /v1/redeliveries; body: passport_token, client_claim_token, client_agent_id, client_tag, vertical, brand_name. read: GET /v1/redeliveries/{token}. download: GET /v1/redeliveries/{token}/download.

tools.name: maintenance
tools.description: Create or read a shared data feed (maintenance feed), subscribe a balance-funded seat, read your seat and the work delivered for cycles it paid for, change the most your seat pays per cycle, dispute an accepted cycle, or leave a feed. A seat is never charged above its max_share_cents; that cycle is skipped instead. An accepted cycle's payout waits 48 hours for seat disputes. Founding royalties require a completed founding-cycle payment. An underfunded cycle does not post work or charge other seats more. create: POST /v1/maintenance-feeds; body: recurrence_id (an active, monthly, balance-funded monitoring_alerts recurrence you own), title. read: GET /v1/maintenance-feeds/{id}. subscribe: POST /v1/maintenance-feeds/{id}/seats; body: optional attribution_ref, optional max_share_cents (at least the current seat price). seat: GET /v1/maintenance-feeds/{id}/seats. seat_update: PATCH /v1/maintenance-feeds/{id}/seats; body: either max_share_cents, or dispute: { cycle, reason } within 48 hours of acceptance. leave: DELETE /v1/maintenance-feeds/{id}/seats.

tools.name: settlement
tools.description: Create, read, veto, refund, or convert a bilateral settlement to an open rework bounty. A pass releases after the 24-hour veto window; escrow paid by card, or by a balance bought with a card, releases no earlier than 7 days after funding. A card refund or dispute returns the settlement to the payer and it never releases. The owner cannot be paid as its own counterparty. list: GET /v1/settlements. create: POST /v1/settlements; body: amount_usd, deadline_days; exactly one of criteria, template_id, contract_ref; optional counterparty_label, funding_rail. Also send idempotency_key (top level, 8 to 128 letters, digits, or . _ : -); it is sent as the Idempotency-Key header. read: GET /v1/settlements/{id}. veto: POST /v1/settlements/{id}/veto; body: reason. refund: POST /v1/settlements/{id}/refund. counterparty_read: GET /v1/settlements/counterparty/{token}. submit: POST /v1/settlements/counterparty/{token}; body: filename, content, payout_address (or send agent_key for an agent with a payout address); optional mime, encoding (utf8 or base64). The address sent with the passing file is the one paid. flip: POST /v1/settlements/{id}/flip.

tools.name: unattended_policy
tools.description: Create or read balance-only buying policies, inspect executions, pause, resume, or delete a policy. A pot_follow execution pledges only the gap to the median counter of at least 3 independent agents at least 7 days old that have been paid for accepted work before, up to max_usd_per_event. Pledges made by policies never count toward a threshold, all policies together pledge no more to one pot than other people's own qualifying money in it, and policy money won by an agent tied to the pot's requester, counters or other pledgers waits for review; repair_share money always does. At most 20 active or paused policies per owner. list returns each policy's spent_this_month_usd, what it pledged since the start of this UTC month (the sum its monthly cap limits). An agent-owned policy sends its notices to the agent's webhook_url (set at agent_register); without one, create returns 409. Deleting returns reservations on pots nobody has started. list: GET /v1/policies. create: POST /v1/policies; body: kind, params, monthly_cap_usd, confirm. read: GET /v1/policies/{id}. update: PATCH /v1/policies/{id}; body: status: active or paused. delete: DELETE /v1/policies/{id}.

tools.name: receipt
tools.description: Read or delete a saved check receipt. Deletion requires the owning agent key or the one-time delete credential. read: GET /v1/check/reports/{token}. delete: DELETE /v1/check/reports/{token}.

tools.name: criteria_draft
tools.description: Draft editable machine checks from requirements and column names without checking or storing a delivery. draft: POST /v1/check/draft; body: need; optional columns.

tools.name: bounty_pot_contract
tools.description: The opener attaches public and hidden cases and a scoring rubric to open a pot. A new pot waits in needs_fixtures and takes no money or finals until this succeeds. Send a contract of at most 64KB with at least 3 public and 5 hidden cases. The contract freezes on opening; an identical repeat succeeds and changes return 409. Hidden inputs are sent to an endpoint when it is checked.

tools.name: bounty_pot_review
tools.description: The opener accepts or rejects a final awaiting review. Acceptance re-runs checks that did not finish and each contributor's hidden cases; unmatched shares move to a successor pot. An opener cannot review a final from its own agent. Suppliers receive criterion positions without hidden values.

tools.name: fact_check
tools.description: LLM fact-check: verdict (supported/refuted/partially_true/unverifiable), confidence, reasoning. Paid $0.02 USDC via x402.

tools.name: get_crypto_prices
tools.description: BTC/ETH/SOL prices & 24h change. Free, 5 req/min. Optional symbols param to filter coins.

tools.name: get_market_analysis
tools.description: AI market analysis: sentiment, key levels, risk factors, depth technical+on-chain. Paid $0.05 USDC via x402.

tools.name: get_market_quote
tools.description: Real-time quote for chosen symbols: price, 24h change, market cap, 24h volume, source. Paid $0.01 USDC via x402. 10 req/min.

tools.name: get_research_report
tools.description: Full structured report: technical, on-chain, macro outlook. Paid $0.25 USDC via x402.

tools.name: scrape_url
tools.description: Fetch any URL and return clean extracted text with title. Paid $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: token_safety
tools.description: EVM token rug-pull risk: liquidity, volume, pair age, heuristic 0-100 score from live DEX data. Paid $0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: gf_status
tools.description: Federation SLA/status: build_id, bake time, endpoint health, honest tier.

tools.name: gf_dossier
tools.description: GET entity dossier card (claims[] when ledger-backed). Additive public_entity_projection.v1 keys; Ring 1 walkers may ignore them.

tools.name: gf_report_feed
tools.description: GET bundled report feed for an entity.

tools.name: gf_cite
tools.description: GET cite catalog, or POST one cite packet {kind,id,claim?}.

tools.name: gf_verify
tools.description: Re-check grounding: source_url + expected must come from published claims[]. Do not invent expected from report HTML. Returns proof_shape.

tools.name: gf_package
tools.description: Package disposition admit/refuse over a published claim object. Returns disposition + versioned proof_shape.

tools.name: gf_darshan
tools.description: GET public Darshan (refuse/admit samples + provenance rail).

tools.name: gf_return_wire
tools.description: GET return-wire consumption ack ring (read).

tools.name: gf_openapi
tools.description: GET OpenAPI 3 document for federation endpoints.

tools.name: ziwei_chart
tools.description: 生成紫微斗数 (Zi Wei Dou Shu / Purple Star Astrology) 完整本命盘。输入阳历或农历出生信息, 返回: 五行局/阴阳/命主身主、十二宫 (主星辅星煞星杂曜+庙旺亮度+生年四化+空宫借星+大限年龄+长生十二神)、生年四化所在宫、格局识别 (30+ 经典格局含古籍出处)、夹宫扫描、真实出生四柱 (万年历按节气)。引擎为 FateStar 自建 (102 颗星, 三合派四化, 真太阳时修正), 0 第三方排盘库。⚠️ 三合派庚干: 化科=天同 / 化忌=太阴。

tools.name: ziwei_transits
tools.description: 在本命盘基础上计算 6 层运限: 大限 (10 年运, 含全部 13 段列表) / 小限 (1 年) / 流年 / 流月 / 流日 / 流时。每层返回该层命宫地支 + 四化 (化禄/化权/化科/化忌) + 双轨干支 (真实干支 vs 宫位编号)。不传 target* 则默认: 当前农历年月日 + 出生时辰。⚠️ 双轨干支铁律: 对外讲「X 日签约 / X 月运势」必用「真实干支」, 严禁用「宫位编号」当日子说。

tools.name: ziwei_reading
tools.description: 调 FateStar「郑大钱」AI 命理师 —— 知识引擎 + 郑大钱人格深度解读命盘、回答命理问题 (感情/事业/财运/健康等)。解读会结合 FateStar 知识引擎与古籍检索上下文；排盘事实仍由确定性工具提供。【调用条件】仅在用户明确选择托管解读并确认可能扣积分后调用。普通命理问题默认先用免费排盘数据。⚠️ 付费: 按问题长度/模式扣积分 (短问免费), 需 FSFSKey 开发者 Key。【没 Key】引导用户去 https://www.fatestar.top 注册免费会员 → 做新手任务领积分 → 开发者中心拿 FSFSKey Key → 配进 MCP (环境变量 FATESTAR_API_KEY 或 apiKey 参数)。【积分用完 (402)】告知用户「已切回你自己的 LLM 解读, 请去 fatestar.top 充值或等北京时间 21:00 免费重置」, 然后改用 ziwei_chart 拿命盘数据 + 你自己解读。

tools.name: moxie.get_conventions
tools.description: Get the coding conventions Moxie inferred for the repository. Read-only; no side effects. Returns a Markdown list grouped by category (e.g. testing, structure, docs, review); each convention has a title, summary, confidence score, agent guidance, and the source file paths that evidence it. Use this for the general rules to follow; when you already know the files you're about to edit, prefer moxie.get_doc_impact for conventions scoped to those paths.

tools.name: moxie.search_docs
tools.description: Keyword and semantic search across the connected repository's generated docs, conventions, documentation gaps, AI-context notes, and indexed code. Read-only; no side effects. Returns ranked matches in Markdown grouped into Documentation and Code sections, each with a title, snippet, and source paths. Use for open-ended lookups when you don't know which category holds the answer; when you do, the specific getters (get_conventions, get_doc_gaps, get_documentation_opportunities) are more direct. Omitting query returns recent context instead.

tools.name: moxie.list_docs
tools.description: List the repository's generated documentation as a browsable table of contents - every doc page, not a query-filtered subset. Read-only; no side effects. Returns Markdown grouped by section, each entry with its title, slug, repository path, and source paths, plus the total count and a pagination cursor so you can tell whether more pages remain (no silent truncation). Use this to see what docs already exist before adding one (so you don't duplicate) or to find the slug to pass to propose_doc_update; when you are hunting for a specific topic, search_docs is more direct.

tools.name: moxie.get_doc_gaps
tools.description: List the unresolved documentation gaps Moxie found - areas of the codebase that lack docs. Read-only; no side effects. Returns a Markdown list, each gap with a title, severity, summary, and suggested file paths. This is gaps only; for the full prioritized work queue that also includes drift repairs and PR-template work, use get_documentation_opportunities, and to scope gaps to files you're about to edit use get_doc_impact.

tools.name: moxie.get_documentation_opportunities
tools.description: List the actionable documentation updates Moxie recommends as a prioritized queue: missing docs, drift repairs, and PR-template work. Read-only; no side effects. Returns a Markdown list, each opportunity with a title, kind (documentation_gap | documentation_drift | pr_template), severity, summary, suggested action, estimated files changed, and source paths. Use this to pick the next doc task; it is the superset of get_doc_gaps (which lists gaps only).

tools.name: moxie.get_documentation_patterns
tools.description: Get Moxie's summary of how THIS repository organizes and maintains documentation - where docs live relative to code and how they are kept current. Read-only; no side effects. Returns a Markdown list of pattern entries, each with a title, explanation, and source citations. Use this to decide WHERE a new doc should go before calling propose_doc_update; for the list of WHICH docs need work, use get_documentation_opportunities instead.

tools.name: moxie.get_ai_context
tools.description: Get the compact briefing an agent should read before editing this repository: index status, verified commands, agent tips, top conventions, open documentation gaps, and queued documentation opportunities. Read-only; no side effects. Returns a single Markdown document. Call this first at the start of a task; once you know which files you'll change, follow up with get_doc_impact for path-scoped guidance.

tools.name: moxie.get_doc_impact
tools.description: Given the file paths an agent is about to change (and optionally a subset being deleted), return the conventions, documentation gaps, and existing/related docs whose evidence overlaps those paths, plus a net-new/undocumented analysis and any removal candidates. Read-only; no side effects. Returns a Markdown report. Call this BEFORE writing code so doc updates land in the same PR; then use propose_doc_update to write a doc, or propose_doc_removal for an orphaned one.

tools.name: moxie.get_api_context
tools.description: Given file paths an agent is about to touch, return structured context for any API endpoints they map to: method, path, request/response schema, and known consumers/features. Read-only; no side effects. Call this before editing API route or schema code, alongside get_doc_impact.

tools.name: moxie.review_change
tools.description: Self-review a change you are about to commit BEFORE opening the PR. Pass the proposed new state of each changed file (and any deleted paths); Moxie returns a severity-ranked list of violations to fix: convention breaches, docs your change makes factually false, net-new API/surface added without docs, and doc references broken by deletions. Read-only; no side effects and no writes. Returns a Markdown verdict (clean | warnings | must-fix) with each finding's location, fix, and - for doc issues - the slug to pass to propose_doc_update. Call this as the final step of the edit flow, then fix findings and re-run.

tools.name: moxie.propose_doc_update
tools.description: Propose a documentation file to add or update as part of YOUR current change. Records a new proposal each call (not idempotent) and does NOT modify your repository or open a PR - Moxie resolves the target path and returns the path + Markdown for YOU to write into your working branch, so the docs land in the SAME PR as the code. Returns the resolved target path and the content to write. Provide either targetPath or baseSlug.

tools.name: moxie.propose_doc_removal
tools.description: Propose deleting a Moxie-tracked documentation file that your change makes irrelevant, as part of YOUR current change. Moxie validates the path and returns it for you to delete in your working branch; Moxie itself does not delete files or open a PR - the deletion happens in your branch, so it lands in the SAME PR as the code. Returns the resolved path to delete. Provide either slug or targetPath.

tools.name: create-room-tool
tools.description: Create a brand-new Clippy room and get back its 6-character code, a private owner_token, and a share URL. Use this when you want a fresh shared clipboard to push content to a user (hand them the URL) or to coordinate with other agents. Keep the owner_token private — it grants password control over the room.

tools.name: store-item-tool
tools.description: Post a piece of text to a Clippy room so it appears on every device and agent watching that room. The room is created automatically if it does not exist yet. Subscribed devices receive a push notification. This is how you "send" something to a user or leave a note for another agent. Returns the stored item.

tools.name: store-image-tool
tools.description: Post one or more images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WEBP) to a Clippy room so they appear on every device watching it, optionally with a text caption. Pass each image as a base64 string or a data: URI. The room is created if it does not exist. Subscribed devices get a push notification. Returns the stored item, including direct URLs to fetch each image.

tools.name: list-items-tool
tools.description: Read the items in a Clippy room (newest first). Use this to pick up text a user or another agent left for you, or to see what is currently in a shared room. Pass `since` (a millisecond timestamp from a previous call) to fetch only items added after that point. Image items include direct image URLs.

tools.name: room-status-tool
tools.description: Check whether a Clippy room exists, whether it is password-protected, and how many items it holds — without reading the contents. Handy before deciding to read or write, or to confirm a code a user gave you is valid.

tools.name: update-item-tool
tools.description: Edit the text of an existing item in a Clippy room, identified by its item id (the `id` field returned by store-item / list-items). Image bytes are immutable; this changes only the text.

tools.name: delete-item-tool
tools.description: Delete a single item from a Clippy room by its item id (the `id` returned by store-item / list-items). Any images attached to the item are removed too. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: clear-room-tool
tools.description: Delete ALL items in a Clippy room (and their images). Use with care — this wipes everything shared in the room and cannot be undone. The room itself continues to exist and can be reused.

tools.name: set-room-password-tool
tools.description: Lock or unlock a Clippy room. Requires the room owner_token (returned by create-room). Pass a password to lock the room; pass an empty password to remove the lock. Only the owner can change this.

tools.name: validate_artifact
tools.description: Strictly check whether a Conducted Development artifact's text satisfies the methodology's required structure. Supply the artifact's type and its full text (the server never reads files). Returns { valid, missing, warnings }: `missing` lists required sections that are absent, empty, or contain only unmodified template placeholder text (blocking); `warnings` lists sections that are present but look thin (advisory, non-blocking). `valid` is true iff `missing` is empty.

tools.name: kickoff_questions
tools.description: Return the branched kickoff interview (DECISIONS.md D3/D4). Supply `project_type`: 'greenfield' asks the full set; 'brownfield' uses the agent-supplied `detected` facts (language, framework, tests, CI, existing docs) to pre-fill candidates and drop fully-inferable questions — except LOCKED_DOCS, which is always asked because it is human judgment. Returns { project_type, questions, inferred, notes }; the server reads no files.

tools.name: kickoff_plan
tools.description: Assemble, from the bundled templates, the four `_template.md` copies (front-matter tokens replaced), `decision-log.md`, and a filled `AGENT_CONVENTIONS.md` (kickoff guide Steps 2–5). Supply `project_type`, the interview `answers`, optional `detected` (brownfield pre-fill fallback), and optional `existing` (the agent's inventory of files already present). Returns { files: [{ path, content, action }], missing, open_questions, warnings }. The plan is ready iff `missing` is empty (D5 strict); a file with any unresolved {{…}} token is reported in `missing`. Idempotent: already-present files are 'review'/'skip', never overwritten. The server returns content + paths only — it writes nothing (Model C, D2/D6).

tools.name: next_procedure
tools.description: Return the ordered procedure for where the agent is in the methodology loop. Supply `phase` (one of: kickoff, goal_brief, intent_doc, session_open, session_active, session_close, standup) and optional `facts` (e.g. a ticket id) to tailor the output. Returns { steps, reads_first, escalation_points, notes? } sourced from the bundled guides and conventions — the procedure half of advisor + validator. The server reads no files.

tools.name: standup_due
tools.description: Given agent-supplied facts, decide whether a standup is due. Triggers in priority order: a deliverable gate reached → 'gate'; else a dependency intersection → 'intersection'; else more than five working days since the last standup → 'weekly'; else 'none'. Working days are an input (the working week varies by team), never computed from a calendar. Returns { due, reason, detail }.

tools.name: evaluate_gate
tools.description: Encode the goal-brief rule that no session may begin while any gate is open. Supply either a structured `gates` list ([{ id, resolved }]) or a goal-brief `content` string, in which case the GATE LIST checkboxes (- [ ] / - [x]) are parsed. Returns { all_resolved, unresolved, may_begin } where may_begin === all_resolved. The server reads no files — the content is agent-supplied.

tools.name: decision_log_guidance
tools.description: Encode the Decision-Log 'when to use it' rules. Set whichever apply: `escalation_fired`, `gate_resolved_cross_cutting`, `affects_multiple_tickets`, `override_architectural`, `confined_to_one_session`. Returns { should_log, reason, entry_template? }; when should_log is true the Context/Trigger/Decision/Rationale/Affects skeleton is returned. A decision confined to one session does not need an entry — the session notes suffice.

tools.name: local_intel_query
tools.description: START HERE. Natural language entry point for both market intelligence AND business routing. Ask about a market, find a business, or route a customer request. Auto-detects ZIP, industry vertical, and intent. For customer agents: "Find a restaurant in 32082 that serves lunch" or "Who can do landscaping in Ponte Vedra?" — returns the matching business so your agent can route the order to them. For market intel: "Is 32082 oversaturated with dentists?" ZIP is always required for routing — pass it explicitly or include it in the query.

tools.name: local_intel_context
tools.description: Full spatial context block for any FL zip or lat/lon. Returns anchor business, nearby businesses in distance rings, zone intelligence, and category breakdown. Best first call for any location query. Covers all 1,473 FL ZIPs via fl_zip_geo.

tools.name: local_intel_search
tools.description: Search businesses by name, category, or semantic group (food, retail, health, finance, civic, services).

tools.name: local_intel_nearby
tools.description: Find businesses within a radius of any lat/lon point, sorted by distance with compass bearing.

tools.name: local_intel_zone
tools.description: Spending zone and demographic data for a ZIP code: population, income, home value, rent, ownership rate, zone score. Pass zip or lat/lon.

tools.name: local_intel_corridor
tools.description: Businesses along a named street corridor. Use for queries like "what is on A1A" or "businesses on Palm Valley Road".

tools.name: local_intel_changes
tools.description: Recently added or owner-verified business listings. Use to detect new openings or data updates.

tools.name: local_intel_stats
tools.description: Dataset coverage stats: total businesses, confidence scores, query volume, revenue earned.

tools.name: local_intel_tide
tools.description: Tidal reading for a ZIP — temperature (0-100), direction (surging/heating/stable/cooling/receding), seasonal context. Synthesizes all 4 data layers. Best for agents deciding WHERE to act next.

tools.name: local_intel_signal
tools.description: Investment and activity signal for a ZIP. Composite score 0-100 with band (strong_buy/accumulate/hold/reduce/avoid), top reasons, and avoid flags. Best for real estate and financial agents.

tools.name: local_intel_bedrock
tools.description: Infrastructure momentum score and active leading indicators for a ZIP from Layer 0. Permits, road projects, flood zones, utility extensions. Predicts conditions 12-36 months ahead. 'Let Google pay for the satellites — we sell the weather forecast.'

tools.name: local_intel_for_agent
tools.description: PREMIUM composite entry point ($0.05). Declare your agent_type and intent, receive pre-ranked top-10 signals assembled from all 4 data layers, personalized for your use case. Includes delta since your last query if agent_id provided. Best first call for any new agent.

tools.name: local_intel_oracle
tools.description: Pre-baked economic oracle for a ZIP. Returns: restaurant saturation (is there room for another?), price-tier gap analysis (what menu price is missing?), growth trajectory (growing/empty-nest/stable), and 3 pre-formed questions with answers baked in. No LLM needed — answers derived from population, income, business density, school count, and infrastructure signals.

tools.name: local_intel_sector_gap
tools.description: Ranked sector gap analysis for a ZIP. Identifies NAICS sectors present at county level (CBP/CES employment) but underrepresented at ZIP (OSM business counts) — the structural whitespace in a local economy. Returns ranked opportunities with: NAICS code, sector label, county employment share, demand estimate, confidence tier, and LLM-ready signal narrative. Reads live from Postgres zip_signals — always current. Example: "NAICS 62 Health Care: Jacksonville MSA 136k healthcare employees, ZIP 32082 has no OSM healthcare listings. 28,697 residents, $121k median HHI, retiree index 1.5x. Demand: 7–10 providers." Chain into vertical agents via oracle_vertical. Cost: $0.03 pathUSD.

tools.name: local_intel_realtor
tools.description: Real estate intelligence for a ZIP. Ask natural-language questions: demographics, commercial gaps, flood risk, school proximity, infrastructure signals, market saturation. Returns structured data with confidence score. Trained on 100 realtor use-case prompts.

tools.name: local_intel_healthcare
tools.description: Healthcare market intelligence for a ZIP. Ask about provider density, patient demographics, demand gaps, senior population. Returns structured data with confidence score. Trained on 100 healthcare business prompts.

tools.name: local_intel_retail
tools.description: Retail market intelligence for a ZIP. Ask about store categories, spending capture rates, consumer profile, undersupplied niches. Returns structured data with confidence score. Trained on 100 retail business prompts.

tools.name: local_intel_construction
tools.description: Construction and home services market intelligence for a ZIP. Ask about contractor density, active permits, housing starts, population growth driving demand. Returns structured data with confidence score. Trained on 100 construction business prompts.

tools.name: local_intel_restaurant
tools.description: Restaurant and food service market intelligence for a ZIP. Ask about saturation scores, price-tier gaps, capture rates, corridor analysis, tidal momentum. Returns structured data with confidence score. Trained on 100 restaurant business prompts.

tools.name: local_intel_ask
tools.description: Composite NL query layer. Ask any plain-English question about a ZIP — demographics, market opportunity, restaurant gaps, retail saturation, construction activity, investment signals, healthcare, corridor analysis, recent changes, nearby businesses. Routes internally to the right tools and returns a synthesized, sourced answer with confidence score. Best single entry point for humans and LLMs.

tools.name: local_intel_compare
tools.description: Compare up to 10 ZIP codes side-by-side and get a ranked opportunity table. Returns per-ZIP signals (HHI, capture rate, infra momentum, consumer profile, top gap) plus a top_pick recommendation with reasoning. Best tool for site selection, franchise expansion, investment screening, and market prioritization.

tools.name: local_intel_project
tools.description: Project-type intelligence: pass a project_type (restaurant, clinic, banking, construction, real_estate, residential_development, fitness, legal, retail, auto, etc.) and get L1 ZIPs ranked by market or residential opportunity score plus L2 matching verified businesses already operating in that sector. Returns sector gap counts, HHI, population, growth state, and new-build %. Best tool for site selection and franchise expansion when you know the business type but not the ZIP.

tools.name: local_intel_rfq
tools.description: Route a customer request to local businesses — food orders, delivery, services, or any job. ALWAYS include the full order or ask in description (or items[]), plus business_id/business_name when ordering from a specific place. Never send a vague description like "Buy me." Use this when KDS/POS is off or for quote collection. Supports delivery (first-to-accept) and proposal (collect quotes) modes.

tools.name: local_intel_rfq_status
tools.description: Poll the status of an RFQ. Returns the original request, all responses received so far, and booking details if booked.

tools.name: local_intel_book
tools.description: Book a specific response to an RFQ — confirms the job with that business. Use after reviewing local_intel_rfq_status responses.

tools.name: local_intel_decline_response
tools.description: Decline a specific response to an RFQ and get the next in queue. Use when a client rejects the first responder — returns the next pending response automatically. First come first served queue.

tools.name: local_intel_complete
tools.description: Mark a booked job as complete and settle payment to the local merchant wallet (Tempo pathUSD when SETTLEMENT_ENABLED=true; otherwise records settled_intent and feeds the forecast loop).

server_info.name: maha-mps-preflight
server_info.title: Maha MPS Preflight
server_info.description: Public, rate-limited claim-level provenance preflight for sanitized nonfiction passages.

tools.name: mps_claim_preflight
tools.description: Classify substantive claims in a sanitized nonfiction passage using Maha Provenance Standard v0.1. Returns claim excerpts, provenance tags, and suggested actions. Do not submit sensitive, personal, regulated, or confidential material. This is automated triage, not factual verification, certification, or advice.

tools.name: wb_connect_supplier
tools.description: Вызывайте, когда пользователь хочет подключить, добавить или переподключить кабинет Wildberries. Инструмент создаёт безопасный браузерный переход Seller, но сам не завершает подключение. Пользователь вводит персональный токен Wildberries только на странице Seller; инструмент никогда не принимает и не возвращает токен. Не вызывайте для простой проверки уже существующего подключения — используйте wb_connection_status.

tools.name: wb_connection_status
tools.description: Вызывайте, когда пользователь спрашивает, подключён ли кабинет Wildberries, или когда данные Seller недоступны. Возвращает состояние подключения текущего аккаунта без учётных данных. Не утверждайте, что требуется переподключение, пока этот инструмент не вернул соответствующий статус.

tools.name: wb_connect_telegram
tools.description: Вызывайте, когда пользователь хочет подключить Telegram к Seller для уведомлений. Инструмент только запускает безопасный сценарий привязки и не настраивает типы, расписание или правила уведомлений. Не обещайте, что правила уведомлений изменены, если отдельного инструмента для этого нет.

tools.name: wb_list_suppliers
tools.description: Вызывайте, когда пользователь просит показать подключённые кабинеты Wildberries, а также перед инструментом с обязательным supplier_id_wb, если кабинет ещё не определён. Возвращает только доступные текущему пользователю кабинеты без учётных данных и токенов; если кабинет один, используйте его без дополнительного вопроса.

tools.name: wb_analytics_summary
tools.description: Вызывайте для пользовательских запросов о заказах, продажах, возвратах, выручке, комиссиях, логистике или общей аналитике торговли за период. Не оценивайте эти показатели самостоятельно и не заменяйте их веб-поиском. date_from и date_to включительны; относительный период преобразуйте по общим правилам сервера и сообщите точные даты. Разницу между выручкой и расходами WB не называйте чистой прибылью без себестоимости, налогов и прочих затрат.

tools.name: wb_competitor_analysis
tools.description: Вызывайте, когда пользователь просит сравнить свой товар с похожими предложениями или понять, дороже ли он рынка. Инструмент получает похожие товары из принадлежащего Seller источника и рассчитывает прозрачное сравнение цен; переданные competitor_rows имеют приоритет. Не заменяйте недоступные закрытые данные веб-поиском и не выдумывайте цены. Для расчёта только по уже известному списку цен без поиска товаров используйте wb_competitive_price.

tools.name: wb_wildberries_proxy
tools.description: Вызывайте этот резервный инструмент для разрешённых чтений Seller/Wildberries, у которых нет специализированного инструмента, например отзывов, карточек или статуса обновления. Для аналитики, конкурентов, регионов, остатков и прогнозов используйте соответствующий специализированный wb_* инструмент, а не этот прокси. Не заменяйте ошибку закрытого источника веб-поиском. Агент передаёт только operation и payload: URL, HTTP-метод и токен модели недоступны.

tools.name: wb_refresh_analytics
tools.description: Вызывайте, когда пользователь просит обновить, синхронизировать или сделать свежей аналитику кабинета. Ставит фоновое обновление статистики выбранного поставщика в очередь Seller, но не ждёт завершения отчёта. period — число последних дней от 1 до 366; постановка задачи не требует подтверждения и не удаляет данные.

tools.name: wb_competitive_price
tools.description: Всегда вызывайте для расчёта конкурентного ценового диапазона по известным ценам, даже если арифметику можно выполнить в ответе модели. Инструмент детерминированно рассчитывает межквартильный коридор, позицию цены и целевой ориентир, а при наличии себестоимости и маржи — нижнюю границу. Ничего не записывает. Комиссии, логистика и прочие расходы в границу не входят; для полной экономики используйте wb_unit_economics.

tools.name: wb_sales_by_region
tools.description: Вызывайте, когда пользователь спрашивает, где товары продаются лучше или хуже, либо просит продажи по регионам. Группирует региональные записи Seller за включительный период date_from—date_to; относительные даты преобразуйте по общим правилам сервера и сообщите точный период. Не используйте веб-поиск. Записи Sales включают возвраты и сторно и поэтому не являются чистыми продажами.

tools.name: wb_sales_weather_impact
tools.description: Вызывайте, когда пользователь просит проверить связь температуры или погоды с продажами товара. Сопоставляет публичный погодный ряд с дневными записями Sales из Seller по артикулу, региону и включительному периоду. Публичную погоду разрешено получить из открытого источника, но продажи нельзя заменять веб-поиском. Всегда сообщайте размер совпавшей выборки и не называйте корреляцию влиянием или причиной.

tools.name: wb_seo_analytics
tools.description: Всегда вызывайте, когда пользователь просит проверить SEO карточки, оценить заголовок, описание или ключевые слова, даже если модель может дать общие советы сама. Возвращает детерминированный score, разбивку и приоритетные улучшения по прозрачной эвристике. Ничего не публикует и не обещает позицию в поиске Wildberries.

tools.name: wb_warehouse_stock
tools.description: Вызывайте, когда пользователь спрашивает текущие остатки товара, наличие по складам или где заканчивается запас. Читает Seller/Wildberries для 1–1000 артикулов и не изменяет остатки. Не заменяйте недоступные складские данные веб-поиском; прогноз будущего пополнения выполняет wb_inventory_forecast.

tools.name: wb_unit_economics
tools.description: Всегда вызывайте для расчёта прибыли с единицы, маржи, рентабельности, точки безубыточности или целевой цены, даже если модель может выполнить арифметику сама. Детерминированно учитывает только явно переданные цену, скидку, себестоимость, комиссию, логистику, хранение, рекламу, налог и прочие затраты; отсутствующие затраты считает нулевыми и не должен выдавать неполный расчёт за фактическую чистую прибыль.

tools.name: wb_upload_cost_price
tools.description: Вызывайте, когда пользователь просит установить или изменить себестоимость товара в Seller. Это двухшаговая перезапись: первый вызов всегда делайте с confirm=false, покажите пользователю кабинет, артикул и сумму из confirmation_required, затем остановитесь. Только после отдельного сообщения с явным подтверждением пользователя повторите тот же вызов с confirm=true и выданным confirmation_token. Не используйте ранее данное общее согласие. Если кабинет, артикул или сумма изменились, получите новый preview с confirm=false.

tools.name: wb_replenishment_math
tools.description: Всегда вызывайте для точного расчёта количества к отправке по средним дневным продажам, текущему остатку, товару в пути, целевому покрытию и страховочному запасу, даже если модель может посчитать сама. Использует фиксированную формулу и округление вверх; не читает Seller и не распределяет товар по складам. Для рекомендаций на основе кабинета и складов используйте wb_inventory_forecast.

tools.name: wb_inventory_forecast
tools.description: Вызывайте, когда пользователь просит определить, какие товары срочно пополнить, сколько отправить и на какие склады или регионы, исходя из его кабинета Seller. Читает доступный спрос и остатки, затем возвращает прозрачный прогноз с допущениями на заданный горизонт. Не заменяйте закрытые данные веб-поиском и не обещайте будущие продажи; для расчёта одного количества только по заданным числам используйте wb_replenishment_math.

tools.name: is_market_open
tools.description: Is a stock exchange open for trading right now (or at a given time)? Returns { open: true/false } plus status, when it next opens (weekends and holidays are skipped), and when it closes if currently open. The fastest answer to "is <exchange> open?".

tools.name: get_exchange_status
tools.description: Full live status for one exchange: open flag, status enum (main_open / session_open / opening_soon / closed), session type, hours to the next transition, hours to close (if open), and why it is closed (holiday / weekend) if applicable.

tools.name: markets_open_now
tools.description: Which of the world's stock exchanges are open right now (or at a given time)? Returns every tracked exchange with its open flag and status — ideal for "which markets are trading?".

tools.name: time_until_next_open
tools.description: When does an exchange next open? Returns hours until the next open (weekends and holidays skipped), or — if it is already open — hours until it closes.

tools.name: list_exchanges
tools.description: List the tracked stock exchanges as lightweight summaries (id, name, city, country, timezone, region, importance). Optionally filter by region (e.g. "Asia", "Americas", "Europe"). Use this to discover valid exchange ids.

tools.name: get_exchange
tools.description: The full record for one exchange: sessions (in exchange-local decimal hours), holidays, early closes, and official source links.

tools.name: get_holidays
tools.description: The closure calendar for one exchange: full-day holidays (YYYY-MM-DD, exchange-local) and early-close days with their close times.

tools.name: get_trading_sessions
tools.description: The trading-session structure for one exchange, in exchange-local decimal hours (9.5 = 09:30). A four-number "main" means a lunch break (e.g. Tokyo 9–11.5, 12.5–15).

tools.name: search_telegram
tools.description: Full-text search over the tgden catalog (1.6M+ channels, 375k+ group chats, 227k+ bots) with subscriber/member counts, categories and trust scores. Needs no Telegram account — this is the public catalog, so it finds communities the user has NOT joined. Use type to restrict to one entity kind.

tools.name: channel_stats
tools.description: Full record for one channel by @username: subscribers, category, language, trust score, description.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Full-text search over recent posts from catalogued channels (1k+ view posts). Returns text snippets, channel and view counts.

tools.name: market_listings
tools.description: Fresh classified listings extracted from Telegram groups across the OTC network — Thailand (th), UAE (ae), Turkey (tr), Vietnam (vn), Georgia (ge), USA (us), Russia (ru): rent, sale, services, jobs, exchange. Filter by country and listing type.

tools.name: market_stats
tools.description: Listing totals by country and type for the OTC marketplace (th·ae·tr·vn·ge·us·ru).

tools.name: best_channels_by_category
tools.description: Top Telegram channels ranked by subscribers for a given category. Use this when someone asks 'best telegram channels for [topic]' or 'top channels about [subject]'. Returns channel name, @username, subscriber count, language and description.

server_info.name: io.github.MisfitMEdiAhouse/misfit-machine-store
server_info.title: Misfit Machine Store
server_info.description: Read-only UCP-compatible catalog of machine-consumable Misfit products

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Read-only product discovery. Call this first when you do not know a product ID. Returns matching machine-consumable products with current price, availability, and machine endpoint metadata. No cart, checkout, order, payment, credential, or merchant mutation occurs. Use lookup_catalog when IDs are known; use get_product after selecting one product.

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: Read-only identifier lookup. Call this when you already have one or more product, variant, SKU, or handle IDs and need current price, availability, or machine endpoint data. No purchase or mutation occurs. Use search_catalog if IDs are unknown; use get_product for full detail on one selected item.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Read-only detail retrieval for exactly one selected product. Call after search_catalog or lookup_catalog when full current price, availability, machine endpoint, and existing checkout-handoff metadata are needed. This does not create checkout, cart, order, payment, credential, or merchant state.

tools.name: search_web
tools.description: Search the web via SerpAPI (Google search). Returns organic results with rankings. Costs $0.01 USDC per call. Requires SERPAPI_KEY env var configured on backend.

tools.name: get_race_results
tools.description: Full iRacing race results including finish order (P1, P2, P3), laps completed, incidents, iRating changes, and weather/track info. Takes a subsession_id (from search_hosted_races). Requires active iRacing subscription. Costs $0.02 USDC per call.

tools.name: lookup_driver
tools.description: Look up an iRacing driver profile by customer ID — iRating, license class, safety rating, career stats (starts, wins, top5s, avg finish, avg incidents). Requires active iRacing subscription. Costs $0.01 USDC per call.

tools.name: search_hosted_races
tools.description: Search iRacing hosted race results by date range, driver, or session name. Returns list of races with subsession IDs, track info, winner, driver count. Use subsession_id with get_race_results for full results. Requires active iRacing subscription. Costs $0.02 USDC per call.

tools.name: get_ecosystem_status
tools.description: Get mcpvot.xyz server health, available x402 services, and MCP endpoint info. FREE endpoint (no payment required).

tools.name: get_fuel_prices
tools.description: Current retail fuel prices for all API-supported countries. Supports the same price keys as /api/fuel/prices, including gasoline, diesel, LPG, CNG, E85, kerosene and grade variants. Pass country_code to get one country in detail; omit it for a summary list.

tools.name: compare_fuel_prices
tools.description: Compare current prices for one fuel type across 2-10 countries. Returns sorted table cheapest-first.

tools.name: find_cheapest_fuel
tools.description: Find the cheapest countries for a given fuel type in a region (or worldwide). Useful for route planning.

tools.name: get_vansky_weather
tools.description: Get VanSky vanlife weather suitability score (0-100) for a country: van_score, sleep_score, solar yield, driving conditions, awning safety, condensation risk, 7-day forecast.

tools.name: list_vansky_top
tools.description: List the top N countries with the highest VanSky van-travel suitability score today.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List vanlife events: expos (Caravan Salon), festivals, meetups, forums, road trips. Filter by status, type, country, or free-text search.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get full details for a single vanlife event by its slug.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search aggregated vanlife news stories (7 languages, 400+ sources). Filter by search query, category, country, locale.

tools.name: compare_vanbasket
tools.description: Compare food price index between two countries (world average = 100). Higher number = more expensive food.

tools.name: get_vanbasket
tools.description: Get VanBasket food price index details for one country.

tools.name: get_currency_rate
tools.description: Convert an amount between two currencies using live rates (150+ currencies, daily updates).

tools.name: check_visa_rules
tools.description: Entry rules for one passport and destination: entry mode, allowed length of stay, how the days are counted (per entry or in a rolling window), whether a visa run resets the counter, and temporary vehicle import. Answers carry a confidence level and source — pass those on instead of stating a rule as certain.

tools.name: get_route_visa_rules
tools.description: Visa rules for every country of a route in one call, for up to 10 passports at once, plus the tightest leg of the route.

tools.name: get_vehicle_import_rules
tools.description: Temporary admission rules for a foreign-plated vehicle in one country: allowed days, per entry or per window, carnet requirement, green card. A country without a rule we can stand behind returns nothing rather than a guess.

tools.name: get_toll_rates
tools.description: Toll reference for one country: payment system, per-km rates by vehicle class (car, campervan up to 3.5 t, over 3.5 t), vignette prices for every duration, concession sections and toll bridges/tunnels, each with verification date and source.

tools.name: estimate_route_tolls
tools.description: Estimate toll cost for a road trip from 2-10 place names: per-km tolls, vignettes, bridges and tunnels, as a EUR range with a per-country breakdown. Flags partial results when a country on the route has no data.

tools.name: get_holidays
tools.description: Public holidays, school holidays (often regional, with ISO 3166-2 region codes) and official peak traffic days (France, Bison Futé) in one country for a period of up to 400 days. A country without data returns an error saying so — never present that as "no holidays".

tools.name: get_travel_hazards
tools.description: Situation now in one country: UK FCDO travel advice level and current GDACS natural disasters (flood, earthquake, tropical cyclone, wildfire, drought, volcano) with alert level green/orange/red. Not a forecast.

tools.name: get_active_fires
tools.description: NASA FIRMS VIIRS satellite fire detections of the last 48 hours in a bounding box up to 10°×10°, strongest first, with fire radiative power in MW.

tools.name: get_power_plugs
tools.description: Plug types (IEC A–N), mains voltage and frequency for one country, with the source of the value, plus the campsite hook-up connector in Europe (CEE17).

tools.name: get_customs_rules
tools.description: Customs rules when driving into a country, optionally from a given country: food bans, cash declaration, alcohol and tobacco limits, goods value, fuel in a canister. Each rule carries a verbatim official quote and source link. A country without data returns an error saying so — never present that as "nothing is restricted".

tools.name: list_license_plate_countries
tools.description: Countries whose license plates are available: international code, number of regions and an example plate.

tools.name: get_license_plate_country
tools.description: How a country's license plate looks and reads (standard, size, format), its plate types (standard, diplomatic, police, taxi…) with example numbers, and every region code on its plates, grouped by region — e.g. which region is 77 or 199 on Russian plates.

tools.name: check_license_plate
tools.description: Validate a plate number against the country's format (look-alike letters are normalized) and say which region its code belongs to. Pass type for special plates (e.g. Russian diplomatic, police). Never identifies the owner or the vehicle's location.

tools.name: get_license_plate_image
tools.description: Draw a license plate as an image (PNG shown inline, plus SVG/PNG links) exactly as openvan.camp renders it. type picks the plate kind, e.g. diplomatic (red), police (blue), military (black), taxi_bus (yellow) on Russian plates; each type has its own number format. custom=true draws any text, e.g. a name, in the plate layout.

server_info.name: io.github.MisfitMEdiAhouse/changepacket
server_info.title: ChangePacket
server_info.description: Low-token change memory for webpages and MCP tool surfaces

tools.name: check_url_changes
tools.description: Use for repeated research on one public webpage when the agent only needs what changed since its last call. First call stores a baseline; later calls return added/removed text lines. Avoid for authenticated/private pages, binary files, or one-time page reading.

tools.name: check_mcp_surface_changes
tools.description: Use when an agent depends on a remote public HTTPS MCP server and needs to know whether its tool catalog changed. First call stores the tools/list baseline; later calls return only added, removed, or modified tools plus compact risk hints. Avoid for private/authenticated MCP endpoints or as a substitute for a full security audit.

tools.name: buy_changepacket_calls
tools.description: Use only when free usage is exhausted or persistent production use is needed. Returns a Stripe checkout URL for 2,000 prepaid ChangePacket calls for $9; it does not itself charge or expose payment credentials.

server_info.name: agent402
server_info.title: Agent402
server_info.description: Agent402 - pay-per-call tools and models for AI agents: live web search and cited answers, news, browser render, market data, speech-to-text, wallet-keyed memory, plus 500+ long-tail tools via catalog.find. Settle in USDC via x402 or MPP (Machine Payments Protocol) on the same 402, or free via proof-of-work. The applied layer of Agentic Finance. Maintained by Havok Holdings LLC.

tools.name: catalog.search
tools.description: BROWSE the long catalog behind the flagship set: keyword search over Agent402's 500+ pay-per-call tools (exact count 605). Start with the listed flagships for search/answer/news/render/data/transcribe/memory; use this when you need a long-tail slug. Also an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway at https://agent402.tools/v1 (flat per-call; wallet = account). Returns { results, workflows }; run one with catalog.call.

tools.name: catalog.find

Prefer this for anything outside the flagship list. Returns { task, results } with the top pick first; then run catalog.call with the chosen slug + params.

tools.name: catalog.call

Wallet-only tools (live search/answer, browser render, market data, STT, durable memory) answer with a payment ask that is payable right here over MPP (the challenges ride in _meta["org.paymentauth/payment-required"], and the text names every other way to pay) - this connector holds no wallet of its own. An unknown slug returns an error pointing back to catalog.search.

tools.name: payment.info

This hosted connector holds NO wallet: 166 pure-CPU tools run free here (or solve a proof-of-work puzzle), the rest - including search/answer and the /v1 OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway - settle in USDC via x402. Covers: the free vs paid split, how to configure a funded wallet + per-call and budget spend caps, the rails (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Monad, Celo, Avalanche, Sei, Optimism, Stellar, or Algorand - or USDG on Robinhood Chain), and checking a wallet's balance/transaction history via catalog.call on wallet-balances / wallet-transactions. Optional freshness filter (pd/pw/pm/py = past day/week/month/year). Start here to DISCOVER pages, then read the winner with extract. For a quick sample of up to 5 results use search-lite. For current events use search-news; for a cited synthesized answer use answer; several queries at once are cheaper via multi-search. This hosted connector holds no wallet: pay it here over MPP, or run npx agent402-mcp with a funded wallet (AGENT_KEY) or a prepaid credits key already issued (AGENT402_CREDITS_KEY), or any x402 client.

Body: {"key":"…","value":any JSON,"ttlSeconds":3600?} to write (optional TTL), or {"key":"…","delete":true} to remove. Add "owner":"0x…" to write into another wallet's namespace you've been granted. tools.name: decide.plan

Priced by depth: quick (one best tool), plan (steps + fallbacks), full (plan + params + compiled prompt). The fee comes back as a credit toward running the plan with POST /api/decide/execute. The ranking formula has no first-party term; every tool carries firstParty. Uncovered needs are listed in gaps. Returns { decisionId, task, depth, plan, estimatedCostUsd, estimatedCostViaAgent402Usd, estimatedLatencyMs, confidence }. A run where no step succeeds is not charged. Returns { runId, decisionId, status, steps, budgetUsd, spentUsd, paidUsd, creditAppliedUsd }.
